Go module `github.com/bide-ai/bide`; [all packages](index.md).

`github.com/bide-ai/bide/chaos` · [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bide-ai/bide/chaos) · Stability: **experimental**

Package chaos is a deterministic crash-injection benchmark for agent runtimes: it drives a NON-IDEMPOTENT side effect through a fault schedule and checks it fires at most once.

## type Report

```go
type Report struct {
	Name       string
	Sweeps     int
	Schedules  int
	MaxFired   int
	Violations int

	Missed int
}
```

Report is the outcome of a chaos run against one System.

**Constructors and functions**

- `func Verify(name string, sys System, seeds int) Report`: Verify runs one crash-free run, an exhaustive crash-point sweep, and `seeds` randomized multi-crash schedules against sys, and returns a Report.

**Methods**

- `func (r Report) OK() bool`: OK reports whether the side effect fired at most once on every schedule and exactly once on every run that reached a terminal state.
- `func (r Report) String() string`: String formats the report as one line: the name, the sweep and schedule counts, the worst fire count, and a PASS or FAIL verdict.

## type Run

```go
type Run interface {
	Step(crashAt int) (crashed bool)
	Fired() int
}
```

Run is one scenario instance: a fresh store + zeroed side-effect counter.

## type System

```go
type System interface {
	NewRun() Run
	Writes() int
}
```

System is one SDK under test: it builds fresh Runs and reports the number of durable writes in a clean run (the crash-sweep upper bound).

**Constructors and functions**

- `func Bide() System`: Bide is the reference System: Bide' durable loop wired to charge once.
- `func NaiveReference() System`: NaiveReference is a deliberately-simple at-least-once loop: it journals tool results and replays them, but a tool whose result isn't journaled is simply RE-RUN, no attempt marker, no halt-on-unknown-outcome.
